Weekly Tarot Horoscope (18-24 May 2026): What The Cards Reveal For Every Zodiac Sign This Week
Tarot Card Weekly Horoscope (18-24 May 2026): From Capricorn controlling aggression to Pisces enjoying emotional peace, know what the tarot cards predict this week for all zodiac signs, including love, career, money and relationships.
Jeevika SharmaMay 18, 2026, 04:00 IST

The week ahead brings a mixed bag of energies; some signs are in for a smooth, emotionally fulfilling ride, while others will need to rein in their impulses before they cause unintended damage. The cards are speaking clearly this week, and it would be wise to listen.

Tarot card reader and astrologer Jeevika Sharma has pulled the cards for all 12 zodiac signs for the week of 18–24 May 2026. Here is what your weekly tarot horoscope prediction has to say about love, career, money and emotional well-being.

Aries Weekly Prediction (March 21 to April 19)

Mood swings are your biggest challenge this week, Aries. The cards suggest you pause before reacting, especially at work. Keep your energy steady.

Taurus Weekly Prediction (April 20 to May 20)

Good news is on the way. Taurus will see positive shifts in both personal and professional life this week. Trust the process; things are moving in the right direction.

Gemini Weekly Prediction (May 21 to June 20)

Be careful with how you communicate with your partner. Unnecessary teasing or pushing buttons could quickly turn into a full-blown argument. Pick your battles wisely.

Cancer Weekly Prediction (June 21 to July 22)

The cards are urging Cancer to give their parents space. Stop seeking constant emotional validation from them and allow them to live life on their own terms.

Leo Weekly Prediction (July 23 to August 22)

If the money flow feels stuck, look at your daily routine. A few practical changes in how you structure your day could open up new financial opportunities.

Virgo Weekly Prediction (August 23 to September 22)

A well-organised week lies ahead for Virgo. Your focus will be sharp and your mind will be firmly set on building financial stability. Stay on plan.

Libra Weekly Prediction (September 23 to October 22)

Before you dive into your next project, take at least 24 hours to rest and reset. Burnout is closer than you think. The work will still be there after you recover.

Scorpio Weekly Prediction (October 23 to November 21)

A happy and socially active week awaits Scorpio. You will find yourself putting in genuine effort to impress both your partner and your superiors, and it will pay off.

Sagittarius Weekly Prediction (November 22 to December 21)

This week calls for a practical review of your romantic life as well as your career path. The cards suggest exploring new travel-related work opportunities and being honest about whether your current relationship is truly working.

Capricorn Weekly Prediction (December 22 to January 19)

Watch your temper this week, Capricorn. Aggression, even when justified, will work against you. Take a breath before you speak, especially in professional settings.

Aquarius Weekly Prediction (January 20 to February 18)

Bottled-up frustration needs an outlet. The cards advise Aquarius to find healthy ways to release tension this week rather than letting it simmer and spill over.

Pisces Weekly Prediction (February 19 to March 20)

A genuinely good week is ahead for Pisces. Expect to feel lighter, calmer and more at ease with yourself and those around you. Enjoy it.

The cards this week are a reminder that awareness is everything. Whether you are navigating conflict, chasing financial goals or simply trying to feel more like yourself, the guidance is there. All you need to do is pay attention.
